name: ghotok
description: Ghotok (ঘটক) — a secure, multi-faith matchmaking platform for Bangladesh (MERN stack).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm start -w server" "npm start -w web"
